title: Moscow Russia Transit Ticket Talon Bus Tram Trolleybus Vintage Ephemera B 57
descriptionText:
Moscow Abonement Talon - Single-Ride Transit Ticket - Bus, Tram, Trolleybus

You will receive the exact ticket pictured. These are photos of the actual item, not stock images. Front and back are both shown, plus additional angles.

What it is:

A Moscow single-ride transit ticket (abonementny talon), valid for one journey on a bus, tram or trolleybus. Tickets like this were bought in strips and validated by punching them in a compostor mounted inside the vehicle - which is why the front warns that the ticket is invalid unless punched.

Markings on the front:
- Series Б, number 57
- The coat of arms of Moscow (St George slaying the dragon), printed in red
- NA ODNU POEZDKU V AVTOBUSE, TRAMVAE, TROLLEYBUSE - "for one trip by bus, tram, trolleybus"
- BEZ KOMPOSTIROVANIYA NEDEYSTVITELEN - "invalid without punching"
- Serial number 801674
- MOSKVA (Moscow) across the foot
- Printer credit along the edge: State Enterprise Printing House No. 12 named after M. I. Lokhankov
- Green guilloche security background with a repeating microtext pattern and a Kremlin tower silhouette

Markings on the back (translated):

"When purchasing abonement tickets, check for the presence of watermarks by holding them up to the light. Abonement tickets without watermarks, and those without fare payment, are INVALID."

Never punched: this ticket carries no compostor holes, so it was never validated for a journey.

No date is printed on the ticket.

Condition: Used vintage paper ephemera, in the condition shown. The ticket has an irregular torn edge along one side, consistent with having been separated from a strip, along with creasing, age toning and some small spots of foxing. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself - the images are of the actual ticket and are the most accurate description of its condition.
